description: This file implements the RemotePlugin class, part of the WPEFramework plugin system, specifically for the RustAdapter module. It handles socket communication, process management, and JSON RPC message forwarding for a remote plugin interface in a C++ environment.

classes.name: RemotePlugin
classes.description: A class managing the remote plugin lifecycle, socket communication, remote process launching, and JSON RPC message handling within the WPEFramework plugin architecture for RustAdapter.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, opening socket connection and optionally launching a remote process based on configuration.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Shuts down the plugin, closing sockets and waiting for remote process termination if applicable.

methods.name: SendTo
methods.description: Sends a JSON message to a specified channel.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Handles JSON RPC invoke calls, forwarding them over the socket.

methods.name: Activate
methods.description: Activates a plugin channel (empty method in this implementation).

methods.name: Attach
methods.description: Attaches a channel for communication, notifying the remote stream.

methods.name: Detach
methods.description: Detaches a channel and notifies the remote stream.

methods.name: Inbound
methods.description: Handles inbound messages based on identifier or ID, returning JSON elements.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes a specified channel (version-dependent, placeholder implementation).

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates a token for a method call (version-dependent).

methods.name: onRead
methods.description: Handles responses received from the remote stream, forwarding JSON to clients.

methods.name: LaunchRemoteProcess
methods.description: Forks and executes a remote process, passing necessary arguments and environment variables.
